searchText: This assumes ETH doesn't grow sentience after PoS and conquer humanity leading to them being implanted with validating brain chips 4 seconds with 1-slot finality and entire set of validators voting each slot instead of a subcommittee I'm hoping in that timeframe for some novel magic system that will allow consensus without validators at all. Alternatively, humanity will have ascended past the point where trustless is a requirement and we can quit using all of this blockchain stuff. 😆 trustless is a requirement for what? :) For humans interacting in interesting ways with people they do not have a pre-existing trust relationship with. One can imagine that colonies of ants and bees do not have this problem. Any bee in the bee colony can implicitly trust any other bee of the same colony without needing to have prior experience with them. Dogs and cats are the opposite, where by default they distrust each other (generally). Hmm, this conversation is probably getting out of scope for this channel/server... we may want to move somewhere else to continue if desired. I can use `http://unstable.prater.beacon-api.nimbus.team` in my Nimbus for the checkpoint sync?
